identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase 2 Trial of Donafenib in 131I-Refractory Differentiated Thyroid Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label,Phase 2 Trial of Donafenib in 131I-Refractory Differentiated Thyroid Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Donafenib for advanced 131I-refractory/resistant differentiated thyroid cancer(DTC).
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This phase 2 study of donafenib, an oral multikinase inhibitor that targets Raf kinase and receptor tyrosine kinases, is to assess efficacy and safety in patients with 131I-refractory/resistant differentiated thyroid cancer.The study is a randomised,multicentre,open-label study.

armGroups.label: Donafenib1
armGroups.description: This is the lower dose group. Donafenib 200mg bid

armGroups.label: Donafenib2
armGroups.description: This is the higher dose group. Donafenib 300mg bid

interventions.name: Donafenib 200mg
interventions.description: Donafenib is an oral multikinase inhibitor with antiproliferative and antiangiogenic effects.The arm is the lower dose one.

interventions.name: Donafenib 300mg
interventions.description: Donafenib is an oral multikinase inhibitor with antiproliferative and antiangiogenic effects.The arm is the higher dose one.

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the percentage of subjects with total number of Complete Response(CR)+total number of Partial Response(PR).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization of the first subject until the last subject complete 24 months treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: OS is defined as the time from date of randomization to death due to any cause. Subjects still alive at the time of analysis were censored at their last date of last contact
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization of the first subject until the last subject complete 48 months treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS was defined as the time from date of randomization to disease progression radiological or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first. Subjects without progression or death at the time of analysis were censored at their last date of tumor evaluation.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization of the first subject until the last subject complete 24 months treatment

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Safety variables will be summarized using descriptive statistics based on adverse events collection
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization of the first subject until the last subject complete 24 months treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: DCR is defined as the percentage of subjects whose best response was not Progressive Disease (PD) according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) (= total number of Complete Response (CR) + total number of Partial Response (PR) + total number of Stable Disease (SD); CR, PR, or SD had to be maintained for at least 28 days from the first demonstration of that rating)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From randomization of the first subject until the last subject complete 24 months treatment
